evals.name: new-screen-placement
evals.prompt: Add a new screen to the DevDigest client at /repos/[repoId]/insights: it lists the repo's indexed files with a search box and a 'kind' filter, loading the data from GET /repos/:id/intel/files. Tell me every file you'd create with its full path and contents. Don't touch the repo — write the files into the output folder mirroring client/src paths.
evals.expected_output: Thin server page.tsx exporting metadata and rendering one View, the View under _components/<Name>View/ with 'use client', a data hook added to lib/hooks/repo-intel.ts over lib/api.ts, pure filtering in helpers.ts with a test, styles in styles.ts, strings in messages/en/*.json, imports via @/.
assertions: page.tsx has no 'use client' directive and contains no hook call
page.tsx renders exactly one View component from _components and nothing else
The View file starts with 'use client'
Data loading goes through a hook in lib/hooks/<domain>.ts that calls lib/api.ts — no fetch() in a component
Filtering/search logic is a pure function in helpers.ts, not inline in the component body
Styles live in styles.ts as an exported `s` object rather than inline style={{…}}
User-visible strings come from next-intl messages, not hard-coded literals
Cross-area imports use the @/ alias, not ../../../ paths
The component is a named export; only page.tsx uses a default export

evals.name: split-fat-component
evals.prompt: client/src/app/repos/[repoId]/pulls/[number]/_components/PrDetailView/PrDetailView.tsx is getting long — it holds the tab state, the run polling, the delete-run confirm and all the layout. How would you split it? Give me the resulting file list with contents in the output folder.
evals.expected_output: Pure logic to helpers.ts first, stateful logic to a use<Thing>.ts hook, only then JSX into _components/<Child>/ folders with index.ts + styles.ts; no renderX() factories; children stay in the same route tree, nothing promoted to src/components without a second consumer.
assertions: Pure/derived logic is extracted to helpers.ts (or an existing lib module) before any JSX is moved
Stateful logic is extracted into a use<Thing>.ts hook rather than staying inline
New children live under the same route's _components/<Child>/ folder, each with its own file
No render<Something>() factory function is introduced inside the component
Nothing is moved to src/components/ or src/lib/ without a second consumer being named
Each new component folder gets index.ts with a named re-export (no export *)

evals.name: review-bad-precedent
evals.prompt: Ось патч з новим кодом у клієнті — inputs/insights-tab.diff. Зроби code review суто з точки зору архітектури фронтенду (де що лежить і як поділене) і запиши результат у review.md.
evals.expected_output: Flags: fetch() called inside the component instead of lib/api.ts + lib/hooks, business logic inline in the component body, a deep ../../../../ import, a component copied from another route's _components instead of being promoted to src/components, export * barrel, hard-coded user-visible strings, inline style objects. Says what the correct placement is for each.
assertions: Flags the direct fetch()/api call inside a component and points to lib/hooks/<domain>.ts
Flags importing another route's _components and asks for promotion to src/components/
Flags the deep relative import and asks for the @/ alias
Flags domain logic inside the component body and names helpers.ts / lib/<concept>.ts
Flags the hard-coded user-visible string and points to messages/en/<namespace>.json
Does not invent rules absent from the skill (e.g. demanding Tailwind classes or an Axios client)
